headline: Committee backs resolution to settle federal retirement pay lawsuit

meeting.body: Maui County Council Government Relations, Ethics, and Transparency Committee
meeting.summary: Committee backs resolution to settle federal retirement pay lawsuit.
meeting.recap: The lawsuit claims the County failed to make required retirement contributions tied to the plaintiff's U.S. Air Force service.[[0:03:45]] A deputy corporation counsel said that after the lawsuit came in, the County learned the plaintiff had cashed out his retirement account.[[0:15:00]] Asked about the claim that the County acted "willfully and knowingly," the answer given was that the plaintiff would have to prove it.[[0:15:56]] A deputy corporation counsel said the complaint states the plaintiff served four years of active duty in the Air Force.[[0:20:10]] The committee voted 8–0 to go into executive session (a closed-door discussion) with its lawyers.[[0:21:08]] A legislative attorney said the closed session covered case strategy, settlement authority, and settlement efforts so far.[[0:26:20]]

moments.q: "we learned he cashed out his account"
